title: Land LTX 2.5 in the app - new LTX models (replace or beside 2.3), the Flows that use LTX follow
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. Moved under the New Models to Test umbrella (Fabio 2026-10-18): the main LTX 2.5 card.

Fabio 2026-10-11: land LTX 2.5 in the app before any more LTX feature work. Nothing on the board covered it: MPI-578 is only 2.5's latent upscalers.

WAITING ON THIS CARD: MPI-1061 + umbrella MPI-1063 (LTX as a second model in Video Edit, deferred 2026-10-11 - it may be built on 2.5 instead of 2.3). Related: MPI-578 (2.5 latent upscalers + the new DiffVAE / "Diffusion Fidelity Rendering", which may fix the 2.3 VAE swim MPI-568 measured; its description holds the 2.5 file list, researched 2026-08-19), MPI-707 (De-RoPE, later on 2.5), MPI-745 (BFS head swap IC-LoRA), MPI-1060 (Ingredients ref2v_ms, built so 2.5 is a loader re-point).

FIRST CHECK: MPI-578 was blocked because 2.5 needs a newer ComfyUI than we shipped (0.31.0 in 2026-08). dev_configs/node_lock.json now pins v0.42.1 (this said v0.39.0 until 2026-10-22). CONFIRMED 2026-10-22: core 2.5 support is in v0.42.1; the ComfyUI-LTXVideo pin predates 2.5. Research: research/findings.md.

OPEN PRODUCT CALL (Fabio): does 2.5 REPLACE the two LTX 2.3 cards or sit beside them? Models are not version-bumped: 2.5 lands as new ModelDef(s) through /mpi-add-model; retiring 2.3 follows docs/playbooks/add-model/README.md "Removing or re-tiering" (never delete the dep entry). Every LTX Flow (Extend Video, Add Foley, Upscale Video, Reference to Video) needs a decision too.
